constraints.name: client_custom_sso_state_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((custom_sso_config IS NULL AND NOT custom_sso_enabled AND custom_sso_secret_hash IS NULL OR custom_sso_config IS NOT NULL AND custom_sso_config_version > 0 AND jsonb_typeof(custom_sso_config) = 'object'::text AND jsonb_typeof(custom_sso_config -> 'validRedirectUrls'::text) = 'array'::text AND jsonb_array_length(custom_sso_config -> 'validRedirectUrls'::text) > 0 AND NOT jsonb_path_exists(custom_sso_config, '$."validRedirectUrls"[*]?(@.type() != "string" || @ == "")'::jsonpath) AND jsonb_typeof(custom_sso_config -> 'subjectClaims'::text) = 'array'::text AND jsonb_array_length(custom_sso_config -> 'subjectClaims'::text) > 0 AND (custom_sso_config -> 'subjectClaims'::text) @> '["subjectIdentifier"]'::jsonb AND ((custom_sso_config ->> 'mode'::text) = 'gateway'::text AND custom_sso_secret_hash IS NULL AND (custom_sso_config - ARRAY['validRedirectUrls'::text, 'subjectClaims'::text, 'mode'::text, 'orcas'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb AND jsonb_typeof(custom_sso_config -> 'orcas'::text) = 'object'::text AND ((custom_sso_config -> 'orcas'::text) - 'enabled'::text) = '{}'::jsonb AND jsonb_typeof((custom_sso_config -> 'orcas'::text) -> 'enabled'::text) = 'boolean'::text OR (custom_sso_config ->> 'mode'::text) = 'independent'::text AND custom_sso_secret_hash IS NOT NULL AND (custom_sso_config - ARRAY['validRedirectUrls'::text, 'subjectClaims'::text, 'mode'::text, 'callbackEndpoint'::text, 'logoutEndpoint'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb AND jsonb_typeof(custom_sso_config -> 'callbackEndpoint'::text) = 'string'::text AND (custom_sso_config ->> 'callbackEndpoint'::text) <> ''::text AND (custom_sso_config ->> 'callbackEndpoint'::text) ~ '^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:[^[:space:]]+$'::text AND jsonb_typeof(custom_sso_config -> 'logoutEndpoint'::text) = 'string'::text AND (custom_sso_config ->> 'logoutEndpoint'::text) <> ''::text AND (custom_sso_config ->> 'logoutEndpoint'::text) ~ '^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:[^[:space:]]+$'::text)) IS TRUE)

constraints.name: client_oidc_enabled_config_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (NOT oidc_enabled OR oidc_config IS NOT NULL)
